mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_schedule (user_id, title, start_time, end_time, note, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{note}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, note, created_at AS createdAt FROM personal_schedule WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM personal_schedule WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
